messages:
jamie_csm: Post kickoff with FoldMetrics (trial). Captured 4 feature asks + 2 immediate blockers. Account health: onboarding 'amber' due to two procurement blockers. Sharing raw notes so product/docs/eng can triage.

- Req 1: per-customer quota alerts (email + webhook) when token spend > X/day. They need SLA-friendly thresholds.
- Req 2: session continuity token so they can stitch multi-request conversations into a single session on their side (across restarts).
- Req 3: UI to compare model A/B outputs on a prompt set (simple eval diff view in console).
- Req 4: server-side retry guidance & idempotency headers for bulk-embed uploads.

Blockers:
A) Embedding latency spikes on larger batches (they see P99 > 6s for batches > 500 rows). This blocks their batch scoring pipeline.
B) They require an example webhook payload and signing secret verification for eventing; current doc links are generic and they asked for a full example with stripe-like signature verification.

jamie_csm: Renewal note: pilot review in 18 days. Customer said procurement/legal will delay if webhook signing and quota alerts aren't demonstrable. Marked 'amber' for renewal risk. :warning:

rachel_pm: Thanks Jamie. Which of these are showstoppers vs nice-to-have? My initial thought: Blocker A (latency) + Blocker B (webhook signing) are must-fix for pilot. UI eval view is medium priority. Quota alerts could be quick win via alerting pipeline.

vik_eng: I can reproduce the embedding P99 on our staging with a synthetic 600-row batch. Looks like backpressure kicking in at tokenization stage. Could be batching algorithm threshold. Need the exact batch shape they used (avg tokens/row).

jamie_csm: Folding a redacted sample they shared: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
{"model":"rw-embed-large","inputs":["...500 invoice lines..."],"batch_size":512}
```
They run in us-east-1 hosted.

vik_eng: Thanks. Quick mitigation: recommend client-side batch_size=250 for now. I'll prototype an adaptive batcher that slices by token count. If product wants this prioritized we can spike a kernel patch for token-aware batching.

pavel_docs: For webhook signing example I can draft a 1-page guide with node/python verification and a sample payload. I'll include HMAC SHA256 example like: 
```
X-Signature: sha256=hex
payload = {"event":"session.end","session_id":"abc123","ts":1670000000}
```
Would that meet their security team's needs?

jamie_csm: Yes, they asked for a stripe-like example. Put both Node and Python snippets. Also include rotating key example.

rachel_pm: Prioritization proposal: 1) Blocker A fix spike (eng) 2) Blocker B docs + sample (docs) 3) Quick alerting pipeline doc + temp webhook (product/docs) 4) Eval UI scoped as product backlog. Approve? @maria_cs_director

maria_cs_director: Approve. If product needs a short-term funded sprint to hit pilot we can approve up to 3 engineer-days to unblock. Keep me posted.

vik_eng: I'll open an internal bug and a small branch for adaptive batcher. ETA for spike: 3 business days.

pavel_docs: I'll draft webhook guide and sample payload today and link to a sample repo. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

feedback-bot: Feedback ticket created: FB-2026-1142 1; Queue: customer-success -> product-prioritization.

jamie_csm: Action list summarized: (1) Eng spike on embedding batching (vik), (2) Docs webhook signing guide + samples (pavel), (3) Product to propose alert config and short-term delivery plan (rachel), (4) CSM to send pilot agenda and procurement checklist (jamie). I'll schedule 20m sync Friday 09:30 PT with FoldMetrics to demo mitigations. :calendar:
